# ParkEase — Data Dictionary

**All data is synthetic.** It was generated by `generate_parkease_data.py` (seed 42) and does not describe real people, parking lots or transactions.

Keys: `users.user_id` ← `parking_slots.owner_id`, `parking_bookings.driver_id`, `parking_bookings.owner_id`; `parking_slots.slot_id` ← `parking_bookings.slot_id`.

---

## 1. users.csv (1,800 rows — 1,500 drivers, 300 owners)

| Column | Description | Data Type | Possible Values | Example | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | Unique user ID (primary key). Numbered in sign-up order within each role. | string | `DRV0001`–`DRV1500`, `OWN0001`–`OWN0300` | `DRV0191` | Join key to bookings and slots |
| `role` | Role of the user on ParkEase | string (category) | `driver`, `owner` | `driver` | Split driver-side and owner-side analysis |
| `registration_date` | Date the user joined | date `YYYY-MM-DD` | Drivers: 2025-03-01 to 2026-09-15. Owners: 2024-11-01 to 2025-09-20 | `2025-03-02` | User-growth trend, tenure features. A booking never precedes the registration of its driver or owner |
| `preferred_vehicle_type` | Driver: the vehicle they park. Owner: the vehicle type their listings mainly cater to | string (category) | `Two-Wheeler`, `Car`, `SUV`; **2% missing** | `Car` | Segmentation; compatibility with `vehicle_type_supported`; imputation practice |

## 2. parking_slots.csv (500 rows)

| Column | Description | Data Type | Possible Values | Example | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slot_id` | Unique listing ID (primary key) | string | `SLOT0001`–`SLOT0500` | `SLOT0465` | Join key to bookings |
| `owner_id` | Owner of the listing (foreign key → `users.user_id`, role `owner`) | string | `OWN0001`–`OWN0300`; each owner has 1–7 listings | `OWN0020` | Owner revenue / occupancy analysis |
| `parking_zone` | Zone the listing is in | string (category) | `Zone A`–`Zone H` (see zone table below) | `Zone D` | Zone-level EDA; key model feature |
| `latitude` | Latitude of the listing | float (6 dp) | 13.0205–13.1080 | `13.049231` | Mapping, distance calculation |
| `longitude` | Longitude of the listing | float (6 dp) | 80.1883–80.2777 | `80.216796` | Mapping, distance calculation |
| `capacity` | Number of parking spaces in the listing | integer | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 | `5` | Denominator of occupancy; utilisation |
| `base_price_per_hour` | Owner's standard hourly price in ₹ | integer | 10–100, in steps of 5 | `60` | Baseline for dynamic price; price recommendation |
| `vehicle_type_supported` | Vehicle type the listing accepts | string (category) | `Two-Wheeler`, `Car`, `SUV` (also fits cars), `All`; **2% missing** | `All` | Filtering in recommendation; imputation practice |
| `is_active` | Whether the listing is live at the end of the data | integer flag | `1` active, `0` deactivated (42 listings) | `1` | Filter candidates for recommendation. Deactivated listings have bookings only before they were switched off |

### Zone characteristics (designed into the data)

| Zone | Character | Listings | Avg capacity | Avg base price (₹/h) | Demand |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Zone A | Central business district | 78 | 3.6 | 64 | Very high, weekday commute peaks |
| Zone B | IT / office corridor | 70 | 5.7 | 47 | High, weekday commute peaks |
| Zone C | Shopping and leisure district | 83 | 4.7 | 52 | Very high, evenings and weekends |
| Zone D | Transit hub | 60 | 5.5 | 38 | High, all week |
| Zone E | University campus | 46 | 4.8 | 19 | Moderate, weekdays only, dips in May |
| Zone F | Hospital area | 57 | 3.6 | 34 | Moderate, short stays |
| Zone G | Residential north | 60 | 3.9 | 18 | Low, evening peak |
| Zone H | Suburban outskirts | 46 | 4.2 | 14 | Lowest |

## 3. parking_bookings.csv (42,378 rows, 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30)

| Column | Description | Data Type | Possible Values | Example | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Unique booking ID (primary key), numbered chronologically | string | `BOOK000001`–`BOOK042378` | `BOOK000003` | Row identifier |
| `driver_id` | Driver who booked (foreign key → `users.user_id`, role `driver`) | string | `DRV####` | `DRV0743` | Driver frequency and behaviour |
| `owner_id` | Owner of the booked listing (foreign key → `users.user_id`); always equals the slot's `owner_id` | string | `OWN####` | `OWN0109` | Owner revenue and booking counts |
| `slot_id` | Booked listing (foreign key → `parking_slots.slot_id`) | string | `SLOT####` | `SLOT0205` | Slot-level history, lag features |
| `parking_zone` | Zone of the listing (copied from the slot) | string (category) | `Zone A`–`Zone H` | `Zone A` | Zone analysis; model feature |
| `booking_date` | Date the parking starts | date `YYYY-MM-DD` | 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 | `2025-10-01` | Trends, seasonality |
| `day_of_week` | Day name derived from `booking_date` | string (category) | `Monday`–`Sunday` | `Wednesday` | Weekly pattern; model feature |
| `hour` | Hour of day the parking starts (24-hour clock) | integer | 6–23 | `7` | Peak-hour analysis; model feature |
| `is_weekend` | 1 if `booking_date` is Saturday or Sunday | integer flag | `0`, `1` | `0` | Weekday/weekend comparison |
| `is_holiday` | 1 if `booking_date` is in the synthetic holiday calendar (15 dates) | integer flag | `0`, `1` | `0` | Holiday effect on demand |
| `slot_capacity` | Capacity of the listing (copied from the slot) | integer | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 | `5` | Occupancy calculation |
| `occupied_slots` | Spaces already taken in the listing at the moment the driver booked (before this booking is added) | integer | 0 to `slot_capacity − 1` | `4` | Occupancy / availability target |
| `available_slots` | Free spaces the driver saw: `slot_capacity − occupied_slots` | integer | 1 to `slot_capacity` | `1` | **Target for Model 1** (availability) |
| `occupancy_rate` | `occupied_slots / slot_capacity × 100` | float (2 dp), percent | 0–90; **1.5% missing** (recoverable from the two columns above) | `80.0` | Alternative target for Model 1; utilisation EDA |
| `booking_duration_hours` | Length of the booking | float | 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6; rare long stays 8, 10, 12 (0.5% outliers); **1.2% missing** (recoverable as `total_amount / price_per_hour`) | `5.0` | Duration analysis; revenue driver |
| `price_per_hour` | Hourly price actually charged in ₹ = base price adjusted for demand | integer | 8–155; values above 100 are surge prices on high-demand event days; **1% missing** (recoverable as `total_amount / booking_duration_hours`) | `74` | Price–demand analysis; **Model 4** |
| `total_amount` | `price_per_hour × booking_duration_hours` in ₹ (booked value, also shown for cancelled bookings) | float | 4–1,224; never missing | `370.0` | Revenue analysis (filter to `Completed` for realised revenue) |
| `distance_km` | Distance from the driver's location to the listing when booking | float (2 dp) | 0.10–5.00 typical; 162 outliers between 5 and 8.5; **2% missing** | `0.57` | Recommendation ranking (Model 2); cancellation driver |
| `booking_status` | Final state of the booking at the data snapshot (end of 2026-09-30) | string (category) | `Completed`, `Cancelled`, `Active` (only in the last 3 days) | `Completed` | Cancellation analysis; revenue filter |
| `demand_level` | Demand for that listing at that date and hour | string (ordered category) | `Low`, `Medium`, `High`; **1.5% missing** | `Medium` | **Target for Model 3** (demand prediction) |

### Rules that always hold

- `occupied_slots + available_slots = slot_capacity`, and `available_slots ≥ 1` (a full listing cannot be booked).
- `total_amount = price_per_hour × booking_duration_hours` wherever both are present; the two are never missing in the same row.
- `day_of_week`, `is_weekend` and `is_holiday` are functions of `booking_date`.
- `owner_id`, `parking_zone` and `slot_capacity` in a booking equal the values of its slot.
- All bookings in the same listing, date and hour share one `demand_level` and one `price_per_hour`, and their `occupied_slots` increase by one per booking.
- A driver's vehicle fits the listing (`SUV` listings also take cars; `All` takes any).
- A driver never has two overlapping bookings.
